episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd coaches a young real estate agent through personal loss and professional stagnation. The discussion focuses on regaining motivation by reconnecting with personal 'why' and establishing consistent routines. Listeners gain insights into overcoming negative self-talk and the importance of mindset in achieving real estate success.
